title: Service Contracts: Early Termination by the Customer
content:
A customer holding an AHL Service Contract may bring it to an end before the expiry date. This page sets who may do so, the minimum part of the term that must have run, the notice period, and the basis on which the shortened term is assessed for dead freight.

## Clauses

1. **Who terminates.** Early termination is the customer's own act, made by a signed notice; no one else can end the contract early on the customer's behalf.
2. **Minimum run of the term.** Early termination becomes possible once the tier's minimum number of calendar months has run from the effective date on the contract record. The earliest date is the day in the month that many months after the effective date which bears the same day number as the effective date; if that month has no such day, the earliest date is the last day of that month. The time requirement is met on the earliest date itself and on the days after it; on any day before it, it is not.
3. **Notice.** The termination takes effect the tier's notice period, in calendar days, after the notice. The contract then stands terminated as of that date.
4. **Dead freight on termination.** The term is assessed for shortfall on the tier's early-termination basis. Under **full term** the commitment assessed is the whole minimum quantity commitment. Under **prorated to termination** it is the commitment multiplied by the number of calendar days of the term that have run, divided by the number of calendar days in the whole term.
5. **Rebate.** Rebate accrued and not yet settled is settled at termination.

## Figures by tier

| Tier | Months that must have run | Notice (calendar days) | Commitment assessed on early termination |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AHL Starter Service Contract` | 3 | 30 | full term |
| `AHL Standard Service Contract` | 6 | 30 | full term |
| `AHL Regional Account Contract` | 6 | 60 | full term |
| `AHL Key Account Contract` | 6 | 60 | prorated to termination |
| `AHL Global Account Contract` | 12 | 90 | prorated to termination |
| `AHL Strategic Partner Contract` | 12 | 90 | prorated to termination |

## Illustrations (hypothetical dates and figures)

- A Key Account contract effective on 31 August reaches six months in February, which has no 31st day; the earliest date is therefore the last day of February.
- A Global Account contract effective on 15 March of one year has its earliest date on 15 March of the next. Early termination is not yet possible on 14 March; it is possible on 15 March.
- A Regional Account customer gives notice on 1 June. With 60 calendar days of notice, the termination takes effect on 31 July.
- A Key Account contract of 1000 FEU with a whole term of 365 calendar days ends after 146 of them have run. The commitment assessed is 1000 multiplied by 146 and divided by 365, which is 400 FEU.
- A Standard contract of 200 FEU terminated early is assessed against the full 200 FEU, however much of the term has run.
